Hostinger review 2026: Is this budget-friendly host still worth your money in 2026? If you’re looking for a reliable yet affordable web hosting solution, Hostinger has been a go‑to choice for bloggers, small businesses, and developers for years. In this updated Hostinger review 2026, we’ll dig into the latest performance numbers, pricing tweaks, feature upgrades, and real‑world user feedback to help you decide if it’s the right fit for your site.

## Overview
Hostinger continues to position itself as a low‑cost provider with a strong emphasis on speed and ease of use. Over the past year, the company rolled out newer LiteSpeed servers, expanded its data‑center footprint, and refreshed its custom hPanel interface. These changes aim to keep Hostinger competitive against both budget rivals and premium players.

## Performance
### Speed Tests
In our 2026 speed tests, Hostinger’s shared plans averaged a Time to First Byte (TTFB) of around 120 ms from a US‑based test node, which is solid for the price tier. Pages loaded in under 1.2 seconds on average when using the built‑in caching layer. The newer LiteSpeed web server contributed to a noticeable boost over the previous generation’s Nginx setup.

### Uptime Record
Hostinger advertises a 99.9% uptime guarantee, and our monitoring over three months showed an actual uptime of 99.94%. Brief hiccups were limited to scheduled maintenance windows, and the support team communicated them clearly via email.

## Pricing
### Shared Plans
The entry‑level Single Shared plan starts at $1.99 per month when billed for 48 months, while the Premium Shared plan (good for multiple sites) is $2.99 per month on the same term. Renewal rates jump to roughly $3.99 and $5.99 respectively, so locking in a longer term yields the best savings.

### Cloud & VPS
For growing projects, Hostinger’s Cloud hosting begins at $7.99 per month (48‑month term) offering dedicated resources and a free SSL certificate. VPS plans start at $4.99 per month, providing root access and a choice of Linux distributions. All plans include a 30‑day money‑back guarantee.

## Features
### Control Panel
Hostinger’s proprietary hPanel replaces the traditional cPanel for most users. It’s intuitive, with one‑click installers for WordPress, Joomla, and over 100 other apps. Advanced users can still access SSH and Git integration via the panel’s developer tools.
